checks.name: production skirmish and definitions scripts instantiate
all derived roster keys exist in production definitions
production wave table and catapult rule are represented
exact directional files route to their exact runtime source
legacy actions are never incorrectly covered by directional idle
legacy action fallback has no other routing mismatch

coverage_semantics.full_action_four_direction: All se/sw/ne/nw resources are selected exactly for idle, walk, attack, hurt and down.
coverage_semantics.idle_four_direction: All se/sw/ne/nw idle resources exist and Art selects each exact directional path at runtime.
coverage_semantics.passed: Contract integrity and fallback ordering only; missing art is reported by coverage gates and does not masquerade as a runtime test failure.

scope: Default 30-wave defense roster, production catapult rule and default economy trainables. No visual, gameplay-feel, performance or human-playtest claim.

source_derivation.trainables: res://scripts/defs.gd producers where is_main_base or buildable
